description: This file contains a sequence of commands and scripts for managing ipset and iptables rules, including creation, verification, addition, and cleanup of ipsets and iptables rules. It uses shell scripting constructs to facilitate temporary ipset creation, rule matching, and safe cleanup, emphasizing fault tolerance and idempotency.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines a shell alias R that executes remote commands, configurable via CRAM_REMOTE_COMMAND environment variable.

methods.name: Skip gracefully if ipset is not available
methods.description: Checks for the presence of ipset and outputs 'ipset-missing' if unavailable.

methods.name: Create a temporary ipset and add an entry
methods.description: Creates a uniquely named ipset and adds an IP entry, substituting process ID for uniqueness.

methods.name: Add iptables rule that matches the set
methods.description: Inserts an iptables rule to match the ipset and drop matching packets.

methods.name: Verify rule presence
methods.description: Checks existing iptables rules to verify the presence of the matching rule.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes the iptables rule and destroys the ipset, ensuring cleanup even if previous steps fail.
